title: Pablo Exclusive Cherry Cola Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Exclusive Cherry Cola Nicotine Pouches bring a playful twist to serious satisfaction. Enjoy the effervescent taste of classic cola infused with sweet red cherries—a dynamic flavour combination that stays interesting from start to finish. Boasting a significant 30mg/g strength, these pouches are tailored for experienced users who prioritize potency. The slim, soft pouches dissolve the nicotine rapidly on the gum, providing a discreet yet intense experience without smoke or vapour. The ultimate choice for soda lovers looking for a high-strength, tobacco-free nicotine solution. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
